title: IIT Madras Opens 17 Online Courses to Class 9 Students for First Time
excerpt: The October 2026 cohort of IIT Madras's School Connect programme extends eligibility to Class 9, offering eight-week courses across 17 disciplines from Data Science to Aerospace.
body:
• IIT Madras's School Connect programme now accepts Class 9 students for the first time, alongside Classes 10 through 12
  • Students can explore 17 disciplines including Data Science and AI, Aerospace, Cybersecurity, Game Technology, and Law through eight-week online courses
  • Applications close September 30, 2026, with courses beginning October 5
  • The initiative has reached over 4,900 schools and 1.75 lakh students, with plans to expand to 25,000 schools

IIT Madras Extends Reach to Younger Students

The Indian Institute of Technology Madras has opened applications for the October 2026 cohort of its School Connect programme, marking the first time Class 9 students are eligible to participate. Previously limited to Classes 10 through 12, the expansion gives younger learners an earlier window to explore specialised academic fields before making critical subject choices.

https://x.com/iitmadras/status/2096926526478676236

The programme, run through IIT Madras's Centre for Outreach and Digital Education (CODE), offers eight-week online courses across 17 disciplines. Students can explore subjects ranging from Data Science and AI to Aerospace, Cybersecurity, Game Technology, Law, Economics and Finance, Humanities, and Engineering Biological Systems.

"School Connect was built to give students an opportunity to explore, experience and understand different fields before making important academic choices. We are particularly excited to open the program to Class IX students this year, because earlier exposure gives students more time to discover their interests and make informed decisions."

— Prof. Andrew Thangaraj, Chair, Centre for Outreach and Digital Education (CODE), IIT Madras

What the Programme Offers

The full list of 17 disciplines spans Data Science and AI, Aerospace, Cybersecurity, Electronic Systems, Chemical Engineering, Molecular Engineering, Architecture and Design, Product Design, Law, Economics and Finance, Humanities, Ecology, Digital Humanities, Game Technology, Mathematics and Computing, and Engineering Biological Systems.

Each course runs for eight weeks in an online format combining pre-recorded lectures, live sessions, assignments, and computer-based assessments. Faculty from IIT Madras and other institutions deliver the courses, which are available in English and Hindi. IIT Madras is also developing modules in seven additional regional languages, according to Education Matters Magazine.

Students who complete the prescribed requirements receive an official e-certificate from IIT Madras CODE. Top-performing students and their teachers will also be invited to the IIT Madras campus for a felicitation ceremony and faculty interaction.

Scale and Ambitions

School Connect has already partnered with more than 4,900 schools and reached over 1.75 lakh students across India. CODE aims to expand the programme's reach to 25,000 schools in the coming years, according to Prof. Thangaraj.

For Class 9 and 10 students, the courses provide exposure to different fields before they select streams for Classes 11 and 12. For older students, the programme helps them understand possible degree and career pathways before college applications.

"Early exposure can make a meaningful difference in how students understand their interests and possibilities. Through School Connect, we want to help students explore diverse fields, broaden their horizons and make informed choices about their future."

— Prof. Prathap Haridas, Dean Academics, IIT Madras

Relevance for Diaspora Families

The programme's online format makes it accessible to students beyond India's borders. For diaspora families considering Indian academic pathways or wanting their children to explore STEM and humanities offerings at India's premier engineering institution, School Connect offers a low-commitment introduction to IIT-level coursework.

Parents are encouraged to reach out to their school management and request partnering with IIT Madras to bring the programme to their students, the institute said.

How to Apply

Applications for the October 2026 cohort are open until September 30, 2026. Courses begin October 5. Students and schools can apply through the IIT Madras CODE portal.
